record.field: Emergency Furniture Order - Groot's New Arms

Customer: Guardians of the Galaxy
Task: Manufacture a premium wooden dining table using ethically questionable wood sourced from Groot.
Requirements: - Must withstand Rocket's questionable engineering. - No splinters. Groot has enough problems already. - Table legs must not spontaneously grow back. - Confirm the wood does not say "I am Groot" when knocked on. - Obtain written consent from the tree before cutting.
Delivery deadline: Before Groot notices. Quality control: Preferably performed by someone who is not a raccoon with explosives.
